item.title: The Japanese macaque
item.description: The Japanese macaque (Macaca fuscata) is a primate endemic to the Japanese archipelago.

item.title: The Sika deer
item.description: The Sika deer (Cervus nippon) is a deer species that inhabits the temperate forests of East Asia and is widespread throughout the Japanese archipelago.

item.title: The Red-crowned Crane
item.description: The Red-crowned Crane (Grus japonensis) is a wading bird from the Gruidae family, and one of its largest representatives.
